How to play charades

  1. Split into two teams and share one phone.
  2. On your turn, pick one of three cards (a movie, song, book, action, phrase or character) or tap Random.
  3. Read it, hide the phone, tap Start and act it out without talking before the timer runs out.
  4. Tap Got it! if your team guesses it, then pass the phone to the other team. Most points wins.
